definitions.gloss: retaliation; payback; tit for tat; getting even
definitions.explanation: Striking back immediately after being wronged. Implies a swift, proportional response to an offense, like hitting back right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らった。
examples.english: I got hit with retaliation right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}ったら→言う：00515_iu⟧、しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{酷|ひど}いこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When I badmouthed him, he retaliated by saying something even worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げたら→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧、{相手国|あいてこく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: When we raised tariffs, we faced retaliation from the other country.

notes:
Originally from a Zen Buddhist practice called {竹篦|しっぺい} where a master strikes a student's hand with a bamboo stick. The student would immediately strike back — hence the {返|がえ}し (returning). In modern usage, it refers to any quick, proportional retaliation. Common in both personal and international contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう: to suffer retaliation
- しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive retaliation
- しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in retaliation; as payback
- しっぺ{返|がえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retaliate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕返|しかえ}し→仕返し：10597_shikaeshi⟧: revenge; retaliation — broader and more deliberate; can be planned over time
- ⟦{報復|ほうふく}→報復：14794_houfuku⟧: retaliation; reprisal — more formal, often used in military or diplomatic contexts
- ⟦{逆襲|ぎゃくしゅう}→逆襲：08998_gyakushuu⟧: counterattack — emphasizes fighting back, especially from a disadvantaged position
- ⟦{八|や}つ{当|あ}たり→八つ当たり：08362_yatsuatari⟧: venting anger on an innocent party — misdirected frustration, not proportional retaliation
